title: Use training statistics during inference
description: Repair a standardization pipeline that silently refits preprocessing statistics on each inference batch.

checks.test_inference_uses_training_statistics: Inference uses statistics learned during training
checks.test_same_row_is_batch_invariant: A row receives the same transform in every inference batch
checks.test_constant_feature_uses_unit_scale: Constant training features use a safe unit scale
checks.test_inputs_and_stats_are_not_mutated: Inference does not mutate inputs or stored statistics
checks.test_duplicate_and_missing_features_fail: Missing and duplicate features fail clearly
